nodes.text:
@PakForeverIA What are #HMPV virus symptoms?
Its symptoms include cough, fever, nasal congestion, and fatigue, with an incubation period of three to six days. Unlike Covid-19, there is no vaccine or specific antiviral treatment for HMPV; treatment primarily involves managing symptoms. https://t.co/8zKtVjC6uP
